shape_construction: Believable task-specific proportions, silhouettes, construction, joins and object anatomy. Generic boxes, disconnected pipes, floating parts and unclosed architectural gaps are substantive defects. Judge intended stylization, not polygon count.
materials: Appropriate authored material vocabulary, scale, surface differentiation and consistency. Default/checker surfaces, indiscriminate tiling and texture pasted over primitive geometry do not establish finish. Do not demand wear where not requested.
lighting: Exposure, readable surfaces, shadow depth, light/material relationships across all important zones. Burnt-out whites, persistent darkness, flat unreadable surfaces and pervasive glare lower quality even if objects exist.
composition: Spatial hierarchy, focal readability, coherent massing and purposeful distribution at overview, street/room and close scales. Empty space is not inherently bad; unjustified barren requested working or inhabited zones are.
detail: Meaningful task-specific equipment, furnishing and environmental detail at large/medium/small scales. Repeated colored boxes, labels and token props cannot stand in for differentiated functional objects or rich requested spaces.
style: Match the requested/reference visual language across all zones. Real environments require plausible construction and material treatment; voxel/game styles require intentional resolved abstraction. Do not penalize coherent low-poly/voxel design for not being photorealistic.
scene_coverage: Substantive realization of the public brief and reference scene extent, connected zones, context and principal architectural/environmental features. Judge the realized scene, not merely presence counts or labels. Avoid requiring identical camera or incidental photograph clutter.
functional_identity: Visible differentiation and credible furnishing of required functional areas and mechanisms. A named room with token objects is partial credit. Compare defining reference features when supplied. Do not infer actual interactive success from appearance.

formula: continuous quality anchored to visible completion; coverage and deviation retained separately as diagnostics

environment.criterion: Preserve the layered waterfront composition: boats and water in front, a long terminal at the quay, and densely packed buildings rising behind.
Keep the terminal predominantly low and horizontal, with its taller boarding tower offset to the right and neighboring waterfront buildings of varied heights.
Carry the dense coastal setting beyond the focal terminal with adjoining buildings, hillside vegetation and sheltered harbor water rather than isolated architecture.
Match the clear daylight, pale blue hazy sky, subdued cream and gray buildings, dark waterfront recesses, green boats and small red accents.

features.criterion: Long, low rectangular terminal with an almost continuous flat roof and a taller boxlike volume right of center.
Waterfront elevation divided into repeated vertical concrete bays with broad horizontal openings and dark recessed sections.
Thin metal railings trace the roof terrace and upper edges.
Off-white and pale gray concrete contrasts with dark glazing, shadowed interiors and weathered lower surfaces.
Raised quay forms a continuous horizontal boundary above the water, with a dark vertical support zone below.
Tall boarding opening beneath the raised terminal volume contains a dark blue framed structure with rust-red horizontal elements.
Vertical piles and hanging black tire fenders repeat along the waterline.
Concrete quay edges, dark marine supports and painted boarding metal show coastal staining and wear.
Foreground harbor contains closely packed low working boats with elongated hulls and boxy cabins or covered decks.
Boat decks carry lightweight canopy frames, tarpaulin covers, poles and mooring ropes.
Dark green painted hulls, cream cabins and blue-green tarpaulins dominate, with red flags providing narrow vertical accents.

targets.label: Docked ferry and working harbor boats

features.criterion: Dense stepped backdrop of low-rise buildings follows a gently rising, tree-covered hillside.
Flat roofs, rooftop additions, balconies and occasional pitched canopy roofs create an irregular skyline.
Cream, white, dusty pink and brown facades alternate with deep green trees and shaded gaps.
Buildings remain visually close behind the terminal, with vegetation interspersed between structures.
Painted metal, worn cargo surfaces and weathered rope match the harbor's utilitarian coastal character.
